entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return an order. Just give me the return authorization.
I can certainly help with that. Can I start with your name and the order number, please?
Alex Chen. Order is 9-5-7-B-4-4. It's a helmet.
Thank you, Alex. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your account. You ordered the Urban Commuter Helmet. Can I ask, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Preference. The color is not what I expected. The box is unopened, I just want to send it back.
I understand completely. No problem at all. I can see you received the item 10 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy. I've just approved the return for you.

I've just emailed you a pre-paid return shipping label. Just attach that to the package and drop it off. Also, I see you're one of our VIP members. To make sure you get the right gear quickly, because your safety is our priority, I've added a credit to your account for free two-day shipping on your next order.
Oh. Okay, that's actually helpful. Thanks.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
